results.title: Performance Analysis
results.bottleneckCpuDesc: The processor limits the frame rate when the city is crowded.
results.bottleneckGpuDesc: The graphics card limits the frame rate. A lower resolution or lighter shadows raise it.
results.bottleneckBalancedDesc: CPU load and GPU load are close.
results.vramWarning8gb: 8 GB VRAM Warning: GTA 6 utilizes dense 4K textures and high-resolution geometry. At 1440p and higher, 8 GB cards will suffer frame drops and texture pop-in.
results.vramSafe: Adequate VRAM buffer. No texture swapping issues anticipated.
results.storageWarningHdd: Warning: HDD detected. GTA 6 streaming technology requires high-speed SSD bandwidth. Severe stuttering and asset pop-in will occur on mechanical drives.
results.storageSafe: High-speed NVMe storage ready for asset streaming.
results.ramWarning8gb: 8 GB of RAM will force swapping while the city streams in. 16 GB is the floor, 32 GB is the comfortable target.
results.vramWarningAverage: Not enough VRAM for this resolution. The model lowers average FPS: ×0.75 at 4K up to 8 GB, and ×0.80 at 1440p up to 6 GB.
results.vramWarningLows: Average FPS stays the same. The model only lowers 1% lows: 8 GB or less at 1440p, under 12 GB at 4K, or 4 GB or less at 1080p.
results.cpuCoresWarning: This processor has 4 cores. Its table score is low, so it limits the frame rate.
